name: GANeRF
definition: A method that optimizes a 3D radiance field representation using a 2D adversarial loss, where a discriminator learns the distribution of image patches and provides gradient feedback to the NeRF to enforce 3D-consistent photorealism.
summary: GANeRF optimizes 3D radiance fields using a per-scene 2D discriminator to enforce photorealism and 3D consistency, distinguishing itself by directly backpropagating adversarial loss from patch-based discrimination into the scene representation.
